components: three plan files on disk: task_plan.md (phases and progress), findings.md (research), progress.md (session log and test results)
hooks: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop hooks wired across 18+ IDEs
deterministic completion gate (v3.0.0+) that blocks Stop only when five conditions align
multi-agent shared state: the same markdown files are read/written by multiple agents in one working directory
SKILL.md standard: one skill definition installs across 60+ agents
architecture_facts: the plan lives on disk as markdown, not in the context window, so it survives /clear and crashes
hooks re-read the plan before major decisions instead of trusting the model to remember it
the completion gate is deterministic: Stop is blocked unless the ledger actually progressed since the last block
multiple agents coordinate through the same files rather than a shared context
one SKILL.md definition ports the behavior to 60+ agents
surprising_detail: v3.4.0 added a PLANNING_DISABLED=1 per-invocation opt-out because read-only research agents and CI review bots that shared a working directory with an incomplete plan were being hijacked by it, with fabricated completions appended to the plan files.
